rows.text: with `i` = `ecx` sign-extended, while the byte at image-base offset `0x2D8E120` + `i` is non-zero it makes the indirect call at `00158F60` + 0x35 with 0x64, and returns -1 right after the tenth such call without re-reading the byte; once the byte reads 0 it returns 0 when qword `02EAE100` + `i`*8 is non-null, else returns the result of the call at `00158F60` + 0x59 with `i`

for each 0x218-byte element from qword `[rcx]` while below qword `[rcx+8]` calls the element's vtable slot `+0` with (element, 0); then, when qword `[rcx]` is non-null, calls vtable slot `+0x18` of the object at `rcx+0x18` with (`rcx+0x18`, qword `[rcx]`, ((qword `[rcx+0x10]` - qword `[rcx]`) / 0x218, signed) * 0x218)

copies `r8d` dwords from `rdx` to `rcx`, first in groups of four (`r8d` / 4 groups when `r8d` is at least 4) and then the remaining `r8d` mod 4 one at a time, skipping without advancing the source any destination slot whose address is null

returns 0 when `ecx` is 0; otherwise takes `p` from the call at `005E2E00` + 0x25 with (`ecx` * 0x40, 4), returns 0 when `p` is null, else copies `ecx` 0x40-byte elements from `rdx` into `p` as four 16-byte `movups` moves each (a null destination element is skipped without advancing the source) and returns `p`

takes `a` from the call at `006560E0` + 0x34 with (`rdx`, 1, `02CBB900`, 0) and, when `a` is non-null, `b` from the call at `006560E0` + 0x4E with (`rdx`, `a`); when `b` is non-null, byte `[b+8]` is 0 and `o` = qword `[b]` is non-null it makes the call at `006560E0` + 0x83 with (`o`, `r8d`, `r9d`, `02CF7480`, 0 as the fifth argument), and a zero result clears bit 0x2 of dword `[o+0x18]`, zeroes byte `[o+9]`, makes the call at `006560E0` + 0x96 with `o`, zeroes byte `[b+9]`, stores `b` to qword `[rcx+0x50]` and returns 0; every other path with a non-null `b` passes (`rdx`, `b`) and then (`rdx`, `a`) to the calls at `006560E0` + 0xA6 and `006560E0` + 0xB1; every path that does not return 0 stores 0 to qword `[rcx+0x50]` and returns 0xD

returns 0 when `ecx` is 0; otherwise takes `p` from the call at `00665190` + 0x27 with (`ecx` * 0x18, 8), returns 0 when `p` is null, else copies `ecx` 0x18-byte elements from `rdx` into `p` (dword `+0`, qword `+8`, bytes `+0x10` and `+0x11`; a null destination element is skipped without advancing the source) and returns `p`

when qword `[rcx+8]` is non-null, for each `i` below dword `[rcx+0x10]` (unsigned, re-read each pass) with `e` = qword `[rcx+8]` + `i`*0x38 it makes the call at `006AA600` + 0x47 with (`e+0x10`, a pointer to a local dword 0) and the call at `006AA600` + 0x50 with `e+0x10`, then zeroes byte `[e+0x28]`; when qword `[rcx+8]` is non-null it makes the call at `006AA600` + 0x7C with (that qword, 0x38, qword `[that qword - 8]`, `0016D6A0`) and the call at `006AA600` + 0x85 with that qword - 8; it then passes qwords `[rcx+0x28]` and `[rcx+0x18]` to the calls at `006AA600` + 0x8F and `006AA600` + 0x98 and stores 0 to qwords `[rcx+8]`, `[rcx+0x28]` and `[rcx+0x18]`
stores 0 to qwords `[rcx]` and `[rcx+8]` and `rdx` to qword `[rcx+0x10]`, and returns `rcx`

with `d` = qword `[rcx+0x50]`, for each of the dword `[rcx+0x70]` records from qword `[rcx+0x58]` (stride dword `[d+0x38]`; none when the count is 0) stores `d` to the record's qword `+0x10`; returns 0

returns 0x11 when qword `[rcx]` is null; otherwise walks the list from qword `02E5C210` (next at qword `+8`) comparing each entry's qword `+0` string byte for byte (case-sensitive) with the string at qword `[rcx]`, returns 0x12 on a match, and when none matches stores the old head to qword `[rcx+8]`, stores `rcx` to qword `02E5C210` and returns 0

notes: 00158F60: the byte array is addressed as image base + 0x2D8E120 + i with no resolved address in the listing, so it is written as an image-base offset; the indirect call at +0x35 goes through an import slot. 006AA600: the + 0x7C call's argument order (array, 0x38, count stored at array - 8, 0016D6A0) is read from rcx/edx/r8/r9 as loaded.
